gross-efficiency-cycling.label: Gross efficiency in cycling
gross-efficiency-cycling.value: about 20% (20.2% and 20.5% in two lab studies of men)

fat-oxidised-energy-per-g.label: Energy per gram of fat oxidised (used with the substrate equations)
fat-oxidised-energy-per-g.value: about 40.8 kJ (9.75 kcal) per gram oxidised; food labels use 37 kJ (9 kcal), the energy of eaten fat after losses in digestion and absorption

running-o2-cost.label: Oxygen cost of running
running-o2-cost.value: about 200 mL·kg⁻¹·km⁻¹ (about 220 in trained men; about the same at all steady speeds below threshold), about 4.1 kJ·kg⁻¹·km⁻¹

co2-energy-equivalent.label: Energy per litre of CO₂ (doubly labelled water)
co2-energy-equivalent.value: about 23.5 kJ on a typical mixed diet (21.1 carbohydrate to 27.8 fat)

alimentary-limit.label: Most energy the gut can supply day after day
